title: Dr-CiK: A Testbed for Foresight-Driven Agents

claim.summary: Dr-CiK benchmarks deep-research-assisted forecasting with labeled supporting evidence, controlled multi-hop documents and forecast-dependent distractors.

modules.name: Controlled forecasting-research environment
modules.scope_reason: Environment construction and evidence scoring are explicitly linked to context-aided forecasting accuracy.
evidence_locators: PDF p.4; passage beginning "To rigorously evaluate CAF"

modules.name: Multi-hop supporting and distracting document construction
modules.scope_reason: Document fragmentation preserves forecast-relevant causal/time evidence while varying retrieval and reasoning difficulty.
evidence_locators: PDF p.6; passage beginning "Phase 2: Multi-hop Decomposition"
